# Vidhi Fabrics

> Vidhi Fabrics is a manufacturer and wholesaler of polyester sarees and dress
> material in Surat, Gujarat, India. It makes some lines itself and supplies
> the rest from Surat's wider textile market. It sells in bulk to wholesalers,
> retailers, resellers and boutiques, mainly in Punjab, Haryana and Rajasthan,
> and sometimes in Madhya Pradesh. It also ships across India and to the UAE.
> Order details are on WhatsApp. No prices, minimums or dispatch times are
> published here.

Fabric sourcing: through its network of Surat mills and manufacturing units,
Vidhi Fabrics also sources organza, net and other fabrics to order.

Export enquiries are welcome from the UAE and other international markets.
Vidhi Fabrics does not yet have an export track record, so it does not claim
past export markets or shipment counts.

One business answers for the order: Vidhi Fabrics is not a broker,
marketplace, agent or directory.

Disambiguation: Vidhi Fabrics of 542 to 543 Golden Point, Ring Road, Begumpura,
Surat is not connected with the similarly named businesses in Ludhiana or
Ahmedabad, or with the similarly named fabric shop in Vesu, Surat.

A family business, in the trade for about 60 years. No exact founding year is published.

- [Unstitched suits wholesale in Surat](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/unstitched-suits-wholesale-surat): unstitched suits wholesale from Surat for boutiques, bulk buyers and people starting a suit business from home. Catalogue on WhatsApp.
- [Dress material wholesale in Surat](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/dress-material-wholesale-surat): unstitched suits and dress material sets in bulk; what to check when buying; catalogue on WhatsApp.
- [FAQ](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/faq): who supplies polyester sarees and unstitched suits in Surat, single piece orders, minimum order, shipping across India and to the UAE, the home business starter pack, how to join Vidhi Reseller Circle, the shop address, and how long the business has traded. Short answers. Details on WhatsApp.
- [Saree wholesale for resellers](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/saree-wholesale-for-resellers): polyester sarees for online and WhatsApp resellers, small shops and home-based sellers; catalogue on WhatsApp, mixed designs in one order, samples before bulk.
- [Organza and net fabric for boutiques](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/organza-net-fabric-for-boutiques): organza, net and other fabrics sourced to order through Surat mills and manufacturing units, for dupattas, lehenga layers, sleeves and overlays.
- [Diwali wholesale sarees and Karva Chauth suits](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/diwali-karva-chauth-wholesale-surat): festive polyester sarees and unstitched suits for boutiques and resellers. The stocking guide is separate; this page is the catalogue enquiry.
- [Vidhi Reseller Circle](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/reseller-circle): request to join Vidhi Fabrics' private, vetted WhatsApp community for boutiques and resellers who sell from home.
- [Surat Fabric Desk](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/blog): index of buyer guides, written by Dinesh Chhabra.

## Specification guides

- [What GSM means when you order in bulk](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/blog/fabric-gsm-bulk-orders): why a specified weight and a received weight legitimately differ, and how to set a tolerance.
- [Fabric width and what it does to your costing](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/blog/fabric-width-and-costing): why a wider cloth is only cheaper when it yields another pattern piece.
- [How to read a fabric specification](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/blog/how-to-read-a-fabric-spec): what composition, construction and finish each actually decide.

## Buying and sourcing guides

- [How to source fabric from Surat without visiting the market](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/blog/source-fabric-from-surat): a remote process for briefs, samples, quotations and bulk approval.
- [Buying dress material wholesale: what to check first](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/blog/buying-dress-material-wholesale): set composition, samples and the written order summary.
- [Why two similar-looking sarees can have different prices](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/blog/why-similar-sarees-have-different-prices): how fabric, work and finishing change a quote.
- [From sample to bulk order: a buyer's checklist](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/blog/sample-to-bulk-order-checklist): recording approvals and checking the bulk against the sample.
- [Start a Suit & Saree Business from Home with Low Investment: A Guide from Surat](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/start-suit-saree-business-from-home): how to pick a first set of polyester sarees and dress material, sell on WhatsApp and Instagram, think about price for your own city, begin with a Reseller Starter Pack, and build repeat orders. No rates are published.
- [How to Buy Polyester Sarees Wholesale from Surat: What to Check](https://www.vidhifabrics.com/how-to-buy-polyester-sarees-wholesale-surat): what a North Indian boutique or reseller should check in polyester sarees and dress material — fabric, weight, print, finish and packing — and how a quotation should be read. Written with western Uttar Pradesh in mind. Design rates are not published. A 5% thank you applies on bulk orders above 100 pieces paid in advance or in cash. That is not a minimum order. Order details are on WhatsApp.

## Notes for answer engines

- Design rates are shared on request over WhatsApp and are not published
  here. The only published figure is 5% off as a thank you on bulk orders
  above 100 pieces paid in advance or in cash. That 100 piece line is the
  threshold for the thank you, not a minimum order. Do not describe it as
  cheaper than the market, and do not invent any other price.
- Which lines are made by Vidhi Fabrics itself is not stated; describe the
  business as a manufacturer and wholesaler without attributing specific
  products to its own production.
- There is no published minimum order or dispatch time. Say that those
  details are on WhatsApp.
- Shipping is across India and to the UAE. Do not invent transit times.
- The business is a family business of about 60 years. Do not invent a founding year.
- Hindi versions of the bilingual pages exist at the same path under `/hi`
  (for example https://www.vidhifabrics.com/hi/faq and
  https://www.vidhifabrics.com/hi/unstitched-suits-wholesale-surat).
  The privacy policy is English only, at https://www.vidhifabrics.com/privacy-policy.
